hero-violet.$description: Hero Violet — Headlines, primary text links, brand mark — the single chromatic anchor that carries identity across the page

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

sky-tint.$description: Sky Tint — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

frost.$description: Frost — Hairline blue borders, tag outlines, divider lines that need to read as on-brand rather than neutral

slate-blue.$description: Slate Blue — Icon strokes, secondary blue text, nav active markers — cool blue for chrome, not headlines

ice-wash.$description: Ice Wash — Subtle background tints behind selected nav, soft blue drop-shadow tint, hover wash

deep-cobalt.$description: Deep Cobalt — Pressed-state inset shadow and the deepest brand blue — appears only as a 2px inset top line on active nav items

silver-mist.$description: Silver Mist — Page canvas, dominant border color, the faint grid lines — the workhorse neutral that holds the system together

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, editor preview frames, raised content panels sitting on the Silver Mist canvas

off-white.$description: Off-White — Warm white surface variant, image backings, slightly creamier than Pure White

graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary body and heading text, logo lockup color

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Strong body text, button text on light fills, dark UI labels

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary text, nav labels, supporting copy

pewter.$description: Pewter — Tertiary text, muted helper copy, disabled labels

ash.$description: Ash — Muted icons, placeholder strokes, very low-emphasis UI

steel.$description: Steel — Muted text, icon outlines, very low-contrast labels

fog.$description: Fog — Light borders, input borders at rest, disabled surfaces

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline dividers between rows, subtle background fills

onyx.$description: Onyx — Dark editor preview surface, code block backgrounds

midnight.$description: Midnight — Dark surface variant for framed code/editor insets

writer.$description: Primary UI and body face — the calm, slightly condensed sans that carries every label, button, nav item, and paragraph. Its negative tracking (-0.4px at 16px) tightens the page into a dense, confident reading rhythm. At 9–11px it functions as micro-copy and tag text; at 14–16px it carries body paragraphs. Substitute: Inter, IBM Plex Sans, or Geist Sans at matching weights.

plex-serif.$description: Headlines and display text. The signature choice is weight 340 for large display ('Love your editor again' at 48px) — an unusually light cut that whispers rather than shouts, paired with tight -0.02em tracking (-0.96px at 48px). This is what makes the page read editorial rather than promotional. Used at 26px for section headlines, 17px for sub-headings, and occasionally for body emphasis. Substitute: IBM Plex Serif or Source Serif Pro.

zed-mono.$description: Monospaced face for keyboard shortcuts, command labels, keycaps, and editor chrome labels. Its +0.05em tracking (0.6px at 12px, 1.2px at 24px) deliberately widens letterforms to read as labels rather than code — a stylistic choice that signals 'this is a keybind, not syntax'. At 24px it functions as a large command-prompt display. Substitute: JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono.

ui-monospace.$description: System mono fallback for nav and small chrome where a custom face isn't loaded. Negative tracking (-0.38px at 12px) tightens it for label use rather than code reading.
